summary: The Calendar app has an event editor with cut, copy and paste, and the SDK reads events in a date range. Apps cannot open an event view, an edit sheet or a calendar chooser; the event UI is inside the Calendar app only. iPadOS 4.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: The Calendar app has its own event view; apps get no viewer controller.
Editing is inside the Calendar app; no app-facing editor sheet.
No calendar selection UI for apps.
Events are read for an app over a date range; the UI controllers are missing.
Apple's bundle resource accessor; BifrOSt apps ship their own resources.

gaps: No event viewer, editor or calendar chooser that apps can present.
The Calendar app's editor is not a reusable SDK control.
